pr_body:
- Return Documents API resources on `/documents` in an array in the results field.
- Add limit, offset, and total in the response body.
- Rename `attributesToRetrieve` into `fields` (only for the `/documents` endpoints, not for the `/search` ones).
- The `displayedAttributes` settings do not impact anymore the displayed fields returned in the `/documents` endpoints. These settings only impact the `/search` endpoint.
- make the `/document/:uid` route accept the `fields` query parameter

Fix #2372
pr_comments: Hey @MarinPostma, as I was saying this morning, can we merge this PR and #2423 as-is and then I'll implement a generic thing to handle both routes.

issue_context.title: Changes in the `Documents` resources
issue_context.body:
## Related specs

- Behavior change: https://github.com/meilisearch/specifications/pull/143
- Pagination of resources: https://github.com/meilisearch/specifications/pull/138, `text/0124-documents-api.md` file
- Handle the fields query parameter for the `documents/:uid` route: https://github.com/meilisearch/specifications/pull/155

## Changes

- [x] Paginate resource:
  - [x] Return `Documents` API resources on `/documents` in an array in the the `results` field.
  - [x] Add `limit`, `offset` and `total` in the response body.
- [x] Rename `attributesToRetrieve` into `fields` (only for the `/documents` endpoints, not for the `/search` ones)
- [x] The `displayedAttributes` settings does not impact anymore the displayed fields returned in the `/documents` endpoints. These settings only impacts the `/search` endpoint
- [x] The /document/:uid route accept the fields query parameter

Pinging @meilisearch/docs-team @meilisearch/integration-team
